text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian President Arafat to Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu: We will not accept security dictates from Israel.
- Histadrut Trade Unions Federation to declare work dispute today, Bezeq disruptions possible this week.
- Arafat says Palestinians would scrap Oslo peace deals if necessary.
- Israeli Arab delegation returns from Damascus: "Syria ready for peace."
- Arafat: I will not kneel. I am prepared to resume the intifada.
- Israeli taxi driver kidnapped, skull crushed by rock and taxi sold for parts in Jericho.
- Israel's Mossad spy agency has new deputy director.
